connectors.name: Demo weather settings
connectors.description: A settings-only example. Saving a connection does not fetch weather or change the sample datasets yet.

settings.label: Location
settings.help: A label for this weather location.

settings.label: Test secret
settings.help: Optional private value for exercising secret settings. It is never sent to an API.

connectors.name: Temperature connector
connectors.description: Reads a temperature observation from the source granted by the host. Register the compiled example module to enable fetching.

connectors.name: Open-Meteo weather
connectors.description: Current conditions, hourly and daily model forecasts. Free non-commercial API; retain attribution to Open-Meteo under CC BY 4.0. Coordinates determine the local forecast timezone.

settings.label: Likely rain probability (%)
settings.help: Rain timing requires at least this probability and 0.1 mm of forecast rain. Hourly estimates are not precise start times.

connectors.name: RSS and Atom headlines
connectors.description: Reads public UTF-8 RSS 2.0 or Atom feeds. Uses the saved feed URL as its host-granted origin. Check the publisher's access, attribution and polling terms. No article pages or images are fetched.

settings.label: Feed URL
settings.help: The canonical public HTTP(S) feed URL. Redirects and URL credentials are not supported.

connectors.name: Luas departures
connectors.description: Live stop forecasts and service messages for Dublin’s Red and Green lines. Times are as reported at the last update.

settings.label: Luas stop
settings.help: Choose a stop from the bundled Luas stop list.

settings.label: Direction
settings.help: Inbound and outbound are the feed’s direction labels; check the destinations for your journey.

settings.label: Trams per direction
settings.help: The two-column board fits three rows per direction by default. Resize or edit its contents to show more.

settings.label: Destination contains
settings.help: Optional case-insensitive destination filter, for example Broombridge. Leave blank to show all destinations.

connectors.name: Dublin Bus departures
connectors.description: Dublin-area bus predictions for one or more numbered stops, using one NTA feed request per minute.

settings.label: Bus stop numbers
settings.help: Up to eight stop numbers, separated by commas or newlines. 2813 is Ranelagh Road.

settings.label: NTA API key
settings.help: Your GTFS-Realtime subscription key. Saved privately; leave blank later to retain it.

settings.label: Routes to include
settings.help: Optional comma-separated route numbers, for example 11, 46A. Leave blank for all routes at your stops.

settings.label: Buses per stop
settings.help: Maximum upcoming departures shown at each stop.

connectors.name: Air quality and pollen
connectors.description: Modelled European AQI, pollutants and seasonal pollen from Open-Meteo/CAMS. Missing pollen data is distinct from a zero count.

settings.label: Pollen focus
settings.help: Pollen is modelled and seasonal; some locations/types may be unavailable.

connectors.name: Daily quote
connectors.description: A cached ZenQuotes daily quote, optional personal quotes, or alternating days. Online fetching defaults to once per day; personal quotes never leave this host.

settings.label: Selection timezone
settings.help: IANA timezone for personal/mixed daily selection, for example Europe/Dublin.

settings.label: Personal quotes
settings.help: Optional. Add your quotes here, then choose My quotes or Alternate. My quotes needs at least one entry. They stay on this host and are never uploaded to ZenQuotes.

connectors.name: Generic JSON
connectors.description: Map one JSON endpoint into typed display fields using JSON Pointers. Public APIs and optional private Authorization/X-API-Key headers are supported.

settings.label: JSON endpoint URL
settings.help: The host grants this exact HTTP(S) origin. Configure credentials in the private header fields.

settings.label: Authorization header
settings.help: Optional full header value, such as Bearer followed by your token. Saved privately.

settings.label: X-API-Key header
settings.help: Optional API key for endpoints using X-API-Key. Saved privately.

settings.label: Records pointer
settings.help: Blank selects the whole document. Use /items for an array inside an object.

settings.label: Observation timestamp pointer
settings.help: Optional pointer in the original document to Unix seconds, e.g. /observed_at. A configured but missing/invalid timestamp fails the fetch.

settings.label: Field mappings
settings.help: Pointers are relative to each selected record. Blank selects that entire record; ~1 escapes / and ~0 escapes ~. Missing values stay unavailable, never zero.

connectors.name: Google Calendar
connectors.description: Read selected calendars from linked Google accounts. Add one connection per calendar; the combined agenda includes every enabled Google calendar connection.
